responsibility: Implements the filename remapping machinery behind -fmacro-prefix-map, -fdebug-prefix-map, -fprofile-prefix-map, and -ffile-prefix-map. It stores per-option linked lists of OLD=NEW mappings, optionally canonicalizes old prefixes, diagnoses malformed mappings, and remaps incoming paths into GC-allocated replacement strings for macro expansion, debug information, and profile data emission so embedded file names can be rewritten reproducibly or relocatably.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation half of the file-prefix-map pair: it owns the linked-list mapping storage, OLD=NEW parsing, optional canonicalization, diagnostics for malformed mappings, and the actual remapping of filenames. Unlike gcc/file-prefix-map.h, it performs the remap bookkeeping and transformations rather than only declaring the API.
